      About Me

      I am a PhD student in Computer Vision at The University of Sydney (USYD) advised by A/Prof. Weidong Cai and Dr. Yang Song. My research interests lie in 3D Scene Understanding and Medical Image Computing. Previously, I graduated with a BCST (Advanced) First Class Honours degree in Computer Science with University Medal from USYD.

      I pet an axolotl and is her name.
      I do lure fishing but it got me nothing at Sydney Harbor.
      I fancy still waters as they generally run deep.
